name: Always Together
storyline: In ALWAYS TOGETHER, you will play as a young man who, with great sorrow, tries to survive the monotony until, one day, something unexpected happens that will lead him to confront a past reality in which he will be consumed by his traumas.
summary: ALWAYS TOGETHER is a 2D side-scroller, created to participate in the RPG Maker Horror Game Jam #5. In this new project, the developers set out to create hand-drawn illustrations and place greater emphasis on the narrative, implementing multiple deaths and some choices.
